_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate favors HOLD; score remains inside 55-62 with neutral funding and ~50 momentum, and no breaker (ETF bid + momentum lift, or breakdown + negative funding) is present.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase but inflow color is consistent with not chasing long
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 55-62, 30d momentum near 50, funding neutral, BTC range-bound
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum through mid-60s with ETF flows turning positive (up into Hope), or F&G under 47 with price break and funding negative (down into Complacency)
